name: Monades
author: Dr-John-8bits, for Flash Dog Duke Silver (fork of Mutable Dreams by Kid Bunka / Christoph Link)
description: Generative firmware for the FM-1, forked from Mutable Dreams 1.1. Six voices, 12 engines (Plaits, Rings, Elements), 91 scales including microtonal ones and ragas, note generators (random, Markov, motif), two LFOs per track, chorus and tempo-synced echo, MIDI out of the generated notes with per-track channels and note zones, morphing between Mondes and a self-drifting mode. 91 Mondes (scenes) including 14 by Flash Dog Duke Silver.
license: GPL-3.0-only (combined distribution); original MIT and MPL-2.0 notices retained
device_test: installed from stock V15 (FM-1_015) on 29 October 2026; identity FM-1_714000100 confirmed after restart; boots and plays. Full checklist in progress.
trs_midi: MIDI in (notes, CC, clock); no MIDI out jack, MIDI out over USB
